```{r}
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(necountries)
```


```{r}
zone_union_proj <- st_transform(zone_union, 2154)
zone_owin <- as.owin(st_geometry(zone_union_proj))

parametres <- list(beta=0.02, 
                   gamma=0,
                   R=50,
                   W=zone_owin)

X <- rStrauss(beta = parametres$beta,
              gamma = parametres$gamma,
              R = parametres$R,
              W = parametres$W)

plot(X, main="Processus de Strauss")
```
